source_snapshot.test_name_items: Check switch function about BIOS SPI Write protect
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check switch function about BIOS SPI Write protect
1.Make Switch to another side.
2. Power on system , negative to jumper function page check.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Switch to another side , systerm still can power onsuccessfully.
2. Switch need functionaly.
3. Switch to orginal side , system should not hang or create error log.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- not runnable by agent: this switch-function check for BIOS SPI Write protect (via the BIOS-SPI-write-protect path ("Check switch function" wording)) requires physically moving the BIOS-SPI-write-protect jumper to the other side, powering on to the jumper-function page in BIOS to confirm the feature engages, then returning the switch and confirming the system powers on with no hang/error. Toggling the onboard jumper and reading the BIOS BIOS-SPI-write-protect path ("Check switch function" wording) page is physical/Pre-OS work only a person at the machine can do.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: operator toggles the BIOS-SPI-write-protect jumper (BIOS-SPI-write-protect path ("Check switch function" wording)), powers on, reads the BIOS jumper page, restores the switch, and confirms a clean power-on with no error log; agent cannot operate the motherboard jumper.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: physical/hardware operation at the machine - human only; agent must not attempt.

historical_reviews.deepseek: NO. Correctly identifies the physical/Pre-OS boundary and restoration path but treats a BIOS page as sufficient function evidence.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY / IMPROVED. V2 adds firmware identity/backup and prohibits an invented SPI write or flash.
historical_reviews.v3: No V3 Pilot record exists for this source key.
historical_reviews.v3_1: No V3.1 200-case record exists for this source key.

original_test_intent: Verify the physical BIOS SPI write-protect switch enters the expected protected-state firmware behavior, then returns to normal boot and firmware state after restoration without unapproved flash writes.
original_method: A qualified operator records firmware/switch state, de-energizes and moves the identified switch, powers on and observes the approved BIOS indication or non-destructive protection proof, powers down, restores the original side, reboots and verifies firmware identity and health.
manual_activity: Physical switch actuation/restoration and BIOS Pre-OS observation are mandatory core steps; no agent can establish those facts remotely.
required_inputs: Exact board, SPI write-protect switch reference and orientations
Authoritative protected/unprotected BIOS page or safe read-only assertion
BIOS/SPI/ME firmware identities, backups and recovery image/path
Power discharge/ESD, boot timeout and OOB recovery
Final state, operator and one-user approval
safety_requirements: Never move the switch while powered and stop on uncertain identity or orientation.
Do not issue any BIOS/SPI write or flash merely to demonstrate protection without a separate target-safe plan.
Stop on firmware anomaly, boot failure, hang, OOB loss or inability to restore original position.
Preserve evidence and do not automatically retry or flash for recovery.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only board/BIOS/SPI/ME identity, console, BMC/SEL and host-health evidence.
Correlate position records with validated protection indication and unchanged firmware identity.
Do not move hardware, attempt writes or set the formal verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve switch/protection semantics and non-destructive evidence.
Perform all physical moves and BIOS observations.
Verify original position, firmware integrity and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its no-command/manual conclusion is sound, but the described BIOS page must be validated and does not authorize a flash test.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the physical/Pre-OS path and permit only owner-approved read-only protection/firmware queries.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Alternate side, function-page check, original-side restoration, no-hang/no-error and 10/20-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: RETAIN PHYSICAL SPI-PROTECT SWITCH TEST; USE NONDESTRUCTIVE VERIFICATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use board-specific position photos, BIOS console capture and validated read-only protection/firmware identity before/after; treat any write test as separate coverage.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact motherboard, BIOS/SPI device and switch implementation.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board, BIOS, ME and BMC revisions plus protection-spec revision.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner SPI write-protect switch and BIOS firmware security specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds firmware-integrity proof and a no-unapproved-write boundary.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No loss; physical path and normal recovery remain required, while unsafe invented writes are excluded.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Switch mapping, protection semantics, safe evidence and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A status bit or page can be stale or insufficient unless the owner defines it as authoritative.

project_override_considerations: A project may add a disposable, recoverable write-denial test only through a separately approved plan with exact target and image. It is not implied by this generic case.
expected_evidence: Board/BIOS/SPI/switch identity, protection semantics, backup/recovery and authorization
Original/alternate physical position plus power/console timestamps
Validated BIOS/read-only protection indication and firmware identity
Original-side restoration, no firmware change, normal boot/no errors and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Awkward function-page wording does not contradict the title or restoration criteria; exact protection evidence remains an owner-defined readiness input.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A safe non-destructive observation can be defined and a qualified operator can exercise the switch; no unbounded write is necessary to perform the source case.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agree with NO but reject treating any unvalidated page as conclusive.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agree with MANUAL ONLY and no-unapproved-write safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates physical switch acceptance from optional destructive write testing.

review_improvement: Protects firmware integrity while requiring board-specific evidence that the physical SPI protection path was actually selected and restored.
independent_technical_reasoning: The source tests a physical protection switch and Pre-OS response. A remote read can support the record, but neither performs the switch action nor justifies a firmware write, so the case remains MANUAL ONLY.
